name: hardening-shesha-app
description: Scans a Shesha application repository for app-level security misconfigurations (not framework defects) and applies safe, minimal fixes. Current checks: over-long JWT token lifetime; token blacklist not wired into JwtBearer OnTokenValidated (so sign-out does not revoke tokens); failed-login lockout disabled or weakened; and a Hangfire dashboard guarded by the starter's app-level admin filter instead of UseSheshaHangfireDashboard(). Scan is read-only; fixes apply one commit per check with dry-run diffs first.
